Sair da delegacia com tornozeleira e ate: Leave the police station wearing an ankle monitor and answer the mysterious phone returned with your belongings.
Chegar à garagem das docas, conhecer o m: Reach the dockside garage, meet the mechanic and learn that your brother is alive.
Concluir os contratos da garagem e reuni: Complete the garage contracts and gather evidence that Boss 1 arranged your arrest.
Vencer a corrida pelo Bairro 1 e sobrevi: Win the race through District 1 and survive the cheating; the chase ends with the death of Boss 1.
Recuperar o carro do Boss 1, neutralizar: Recover Boss 1's car, disable the ankle monitor and choose your next destination.
Roubar um sedã estacionado e entregá-lo: Steal a parked sedan and deliver it with at least 60% condition.
Entregar dois veículos de pontos diferen: Deliver two vehicles from different locations before time runs out.
Retirar um veículo apreendido sem destru: Recover an impounded vehicle without destroying it; the glove compartment holds a clue about your brother.
Interceptar o carro de um corredor dos C: Intercept a Cobras racer's car and use it to gain entry to the final race.
